✦ About LifeTrack

Take a moment
for yourself

Life gets overwhelming sometimes. LifeTrack is here to help you pause, breathe, and reconnect with yourself. It is a safe space where you can express yourself freely, get personalized wellness guidance, and find the motivation to keep going.

I'm here to offer guidance and support, no matter what you're going through. Just try, adapt, and most importantly — be kind to yourself.

"Your circle shapes your destiny — choose people who are spiritual, ambitious, and growth-driven. No such circle yet? I'm right here for you. 🌿"
🌿

Breathe

You're doing better than you think. Take a moment to appreciate how far you've come.

🧠

Reflect

Not everything has to be figured out today. Sit with your thoughts calmly and patiently.

🌼

Grow

You're allowed to take things slow. Growing at your own pace is still growth.

Gayatri Mantra

ॐ भूर्भुवः स्वः तत्सवितुर्वरेण्यं भर्गो देवस्य धीमहि धियो यो नः प्रचोदयात्॥

For clarity, wisdom, and inner light. Best chanted at sunrise.

Morning ritual: कराग्रे वसते लक्ष्मी, करमध्ये सरस्वती। करमूले तु गोविन्द, प्रभाते करदर्शनम्। — one of the best ways to start your day is by writing a positive journal and chanting mantras.

🕉️

Hare Krishna Maha Mantra

हरे कृष्ण हरे कृष्ण कृष्ण कृष्ण हरे हरे । हरे राम हरे राम राम राम हरे हरे ॥

Hare Krishna Hare Krishna, Krishna Krishna Hare Hare, Hare Ram Hare Ram, Ram Ram Hare Hare.

For inner peace, surrender, and releasing what no longer serves you.

🕉️

Maha Mrityunjaya Mantra

ॐ त्र्यम्बकं यजामहे सुगन्धिं पुष्टिवर्धनम् । उर्वारुकमिव बन्धनान् मृत्योर्मुक्षीय माऽमृतत् ॥

Om Tryambakam Yajamahe Sugandhim Pushtivardhanam, Urvarukamiva Bandhanan Mrityor Mukshiya Maamritat.

For healing, protection, and strength during difficult times.

🕉️

Om Namo Bhagavate Vasudevaya

A simple, calming mantra to center yourself before sleep or meditation. Chanting just after waking up and right before sleeping helps carry peace through your whole day.

📖

💜

"Sometimes, When Things Are Falling Apart, They Are Really Falling Into Place."

Repeat this when you feel behind in life. Your timeline is your own.

💜

"Men of Actions Are Favoured By The Goddess Of Good Luck."

Growth is often invisible until you look back. Trust the process.

💜

"I Love The Person I Am Today, I Love The Person I Am Becoming, I Love The Person I Have Grown To Be."

Let go of needing everything to be perfect. Progress is enough.

💜

"I am worthy of the good things coming my way."

You don't have to earn rest, love, or good things. You already deserve them.

Why Gym Helps Your Mind, Not Just Your Body

Exercise releases endorphins that reduce stress, anxiety, and depression naturally — even 20 minutes makes a difference.

🏃

Start Small

You don't need a gym membership to start. A 15 minute walk or home workout counts too.

🧘

Movement as Meditation

Physical activity gives your overthinking mind a break — it forces you into the present moment.

📅

Consistency Over Intensity

Going 3 times a week consistently beats one intense session a month. Build the habit first.
